text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea secondary to levofloxacin therapy. I suspect this may be C. difficile colitis given the recent antibiotic use and severity of symptoms. I recommend we hold the levofloxacin immediately and obtain a Stool C. difficile Toxin A/B assay.
